name: Pixie
flavor: A wandering mote-courier who got lost between shrines and never looked back.

recruitEvent.greeting: A glowing Pixie flutters near you! 'You look exhausted! Let me soothe your wounds.'
recruitEvent.acceptText: Pixie smiles warmly. 'May I travel with you?'

name: High Pixie
flavor: A pixie that has attained a higher state of being.

name: Skeleton
flavor: A reanimated corpse that just wants to go back to sleep.

recruitEvent.greeting: A Skeleton rattles its blade and tests your fighting spirit!
recruitEvent.acceptText: The Skeleton lowers its sword in respect. 'Your combat skill is worthy of my blade.'

name: Angel
flavor: A celestial being tasked with guiding the lost. Its patience is legendary.

recruitEvent.greeting: A radiant Angel hovers gracefully. 'A modest offering of 30 Gold shall fund my holy crusade.'
recruitEvent.acceptText: Angel accepts the offering. 'May divine light guide our path.'

name: Archangel
flavor: A celestial being tasked with guiding the lost. Its patience is legendary.

name: Demon
flavor: A pact-bound fiend that revels in chaos and destruction.

name: Incubus
flavor: A demon that invades dreams to steal vitality.

name: Nurse
flavor: She's here to help. Please don't resist.

recruitEvent.greeting: Nurse approaches softly. 'Hold still, let me mend your injuries.'
recruitEvent.acceptText: Nurse smiles gently. 'I shall watch over your health.'

name: Imp
flavor: A mischievous lesser demon that enjoys playing pranks.

recruitEvent.greeting: A mischievous Imp rattles a pouch of coins. 'Hand over 15 Gold and I'll fight for you!'
recruitEvent.acceptText: Imp snatches the coins greedily. 'Keke! Deal!'

name: Golem
flavor: An animated statue, slow but incredibly durable.

recruitEvent.greeting: A massive Golem looms over you, raising its heavy stone fists!
recruitEvent.acceptText: The Golem kneels in respect. 'I yield to your power. I shall be your shield.'

name: Ghoul
flavor: An animated statue, slow but incredibly durable.

name: Ooze

recruitEvent.greeting: A sickly Ooze quivers helplessly, needing a Potion to stabilize...
recruitEvent.acceptText: The Ooze absorbs the potion and bubbles with delight!

flavor: A patient mass that accepts almost anything into itself. Its unusual resilience makes it useful in battle and Item Creation.

name: Bat

recruitEvent.greeting: A friendly Bat flaps softly around your head and offers to join!

flavor: A frail cave flier guided by sound rather than sight. Its low burden and speed reward careful positioning.

name: Wisp

recruitEvent.greeting: A weak Wisp flickers faintly on the dungeon floor, needing a Potion...
recruitEvent.acceptText: The Wisp absorbs the potion and glows brightly with gratitude!

flavor: A drifting light that quietly mends its companions while traveling. It is fragile, expensive to manifest, and invaluable on long expeditions.

name: Egg
flavor: A creature whose shell conceals an outcome fixed by its provenance. Keep it alive until level ten and the dungeon will reveal what was inside.

name: Phoenix
flavor: A sacred bird hatched from a Mystic Egg. Its tremendous power is matched by an exceptional MP burden.

name: Larva
flavor: It's eating your rations. And your tank.

name: Crimson Lord
flavor: He has drunk his fill, and now commands the blood.

name: Flauros
flavor: A savage leopard demon. It smells of brimstone and burnt hair.

name: Candle
flavor: A simple wax candle given life. Ideally, keep it away from the library.

recruitEvent.greeting: A tiny animated Candle flickers cheerfully and wants to accompany you!

name: Shadow Stalker
flavor: A patient hunter that steps between shadows. Its speed and critical strikes reward precise aggression.

name: Alex
flavor: A summoner bound to creatures by shared MP and shared consequence. Every expedition is shaped by whom Alex chooses to manifest.

name: Undine
flavor: A water spirit learning to shape cold into magic. Its adaptable spellwork rewards patient raising.

name: Proteus
flavor: An androgynous water sage whose fluid body can hold the front line. It exchanges simple frost for healing and protection.

name: Cocoon
flavor: Something enormous dreams behind the silk. Its patient light unsettles enemies even before it hatches.

name: Notiluca
flavor: A giant moth whose wings pulse like a midnight lantern. Its mesmerizing light turns an enemy formation against itself.

name: Gbl. Thief
flavor: A quick-fingered goblin who knows when a fight has gone sour. Cheap to maintain, it excels at scouting and escape.

name: Gbl. Prince
flavor: A goblin whose stolen crown has become strangely legitimate. It turns underhanded survival tricks into party leadership.

name: Homunculus
flavor: An unfinished life cultivated in alchemical glass. Its future form is visible, but the reason for that destiny is deliberately obscure.

name: Mandrake
flavor: A stubborn medicinal root with an alarming voice. It is more valuable in the kitchen than its humble appearance suggests.

name: Alraune
flavor: A flowering plant spirit steeped in restorative sap. Its cooking and support magic can sustain an entire expedition.

name: Cerberus
flavor: A three-headed guardian recruited long before most summoners can comfortably afford it. Its early power is balanced by poor growth and a hungry MP burden.

name: Diablos
flavor: A demon sealed inside the Forbidden Lamp. It joins only the summoner who survives its judgment and feeds that master MP with every killing blow.

name: Dragon
flavor: A young dragon whose element has not yet settled. The player may choose which affinity will shape its first promotion.

name: Red Dragon
flavor: A dragon tempered by red flame. Its breath and forgecraft favor direct offense.

name: Salamander
flavor: A mythic fire dragon awakened by a branch-specific catalyst. It distills destruction into the finest red creations.

name: Blue Dragon
flavor: A dragon steeped in cold blue currents. It favors magical pressure and water-aligned creation.

name: Leviathan
flavor: A sovereign sea dragon promoted through a rare blue catalyst. Its immense breath rolls across whole formations.

name: Green Dragon
flavor: A green dragon shaped by wind and living earth. It is the swiftest and most expedition-minded of its siblings.

name: Fafnir
flavor: A legendary green dragon whose hunger has hardened into cunning. Its craft bends natural ingredients toward rare results.

name: White Dragon
flavor: A white dragon radiant with disciplined force. It protects allies without abandoning draconic power.

name: Bahamut
flavor: A heavenly dragon released by a sacred catalyst. Its presence turns defense and white creation into acts of majesty.

name: Black Dragon
flavor: A black dragon carrying the stillness of deep caverns. Its magic erodes defenses before the final strike.

name: Nidhogg
flavor: A deathly dragon unlocked by a forbidden black catalyst. It specializes in ruinous magic and dangerous creation.

name: Giant
flavor: A young giant with strength enough to choose between fury and endurance. Its promotion branch is a direct player decision.

name: Hill Gigas
flavor: A red-and-black giant modeled after the hill titans of old tales. It is the more magical and aggressively destructive branch.

name: Surtr
flavor: A fire giant awakened by a molten relic. It turns the Hill Gigas's aggression into apocalyptic force.

name: Atlas
flavor: A white-and-green giant built to bear impossible burdens. It is more physical, defensive, and reliable than Hill Gigas.

name: Hyperion
flavor: A celestial titan promoted through an adamant relic. Its defense becomes a foundation the whole party can fight around.

name: Mimic
flavor: A living chest with a talent for making items work harder. It is sturdy, opportunistic, and available for promotion immediately.

name: Pandora
flavor: A Mimic opened by the Black Hinge into something stranger. It is somewhat stronger and frailer, with exceptional command of items.

name: Unicorn
flavor: A gentle horned mount with instinctive healing magic. Several promotions let it become a traveler, healer, nightmare, or fire steed.

name: Sleipnir
flavor: An eight-legged mount that trades spectacle for speed and expedition efficiency. It remains capable of basic healing.

name: Kirin
flavor: A sacred healer unlocked from Sleipnir by a rare bell. It cleanses afflictions and bestows regeneration on the entire party.

name: Nightmare
flavor: A Unicorn that surrendered its healing light to black flame. It is the family's lone branch without basic restorative magic.

name: Firemane
flavor: A fiery mount reached through an accessible catalyst. It preserves simple healing while adding aggressive red magic.

name: Talos
flavor: A Golem perfected through a celestial fossil. It remains an uncompromising physical wall with a catastrophic weakness to magic.

name: Gargoyle
flavor: A watchful stone fiend more magical than a Golem. It provokes attacks and raises the party's magical defenses.

name: Grotesque
flavor: A Gargoyle whose protective sorcery has grown stranger and stronger. It anchors the party through provocation and magical shelter.

name: Kappa
flavor: A sturdy river creature whose greatest talents lie outside battle. Some victims of kappa curses can regain their former shape by surviving long enough.

name: Moa
flavor: A peculiar pink mount bird descended from an Egg. Its strange silhouette hides excellent expedition utility.

name: Titania
flavor: A High Pixie raised all the way to level twenty without a catalyst. The fairy court answers her with powerful support magic.
